interpretation: literal_serial charges measured exact Q8 tile work, measured service fixed work, the measured bounded-N256 tax, and all pair-local dispatch/return time in series.
Exact Q8 work is tiled independently for each original 2,032-token lane. Rows are never concatenated across lanes, so M64/M32/M16 arithmetic classes match the byte-identical PairWave service.
streamed-copy scenarios are bounds until a tile-level pair service probe measures the exposed first/last-copy bubbles.
pairfold scenarios replace only the exact recurrent and attention cores with previously measured exact HeadFold and 256-key-aligned chunk results.
Zero N256 tax denotes the accepted 274,661,376-byte N2048 phase-reused arena, not a hypothetical fused kernel. It reclaims 892,000,048 bytes/GPU.
The N512 scenarios use the measured pair-shaped 0.235001 ms panel tax and the 131,017,728-byte phase-reused arena. The isolated pair-return probe must bound copy exposure.

The replay charges causal handoff latency but not copy-engine contention between a handoff and pair-local MoE. A candidate must pass a composed two-layer probe before this is treated as a production prediction.
pairwave-replay-v1.json used pooled route lists and is invalid for exact production projections. This v2 schema supersedes that performance claim.
